Welcome to the TASFAA Conference Mini Site!

The annual conference of the Texas Association of Financial Aid Administrators (TASFAA) provides valuable, up-to-date information on the student aid programs from financial aid veterans. The conference is a unique training and professional development opportunity that will equip student aid professionals with the tools to better serve students and their families. Attendees can receive individual guidance from conference participants like the U.S. Department of Education and the Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board.

This year’s Key Note speaker is Jan Hargrave, motivational and educational speaker of Jan Hargrave & Associates, a Houston based consulting firm. TASFAA participants had the pleasure of listening to Jan at the annual TASFAA conference in 1999 at the Del Lago resort in Conroe. This is sure to be one of the most enlightening key notes you will ever hear.

This year we will have two general sessions on Wednesday afternoon after the opening luncheon. Justin Dreager, President of the National Association of Financial Aid Administrators will speak to conference participants about happenings at NASFAA. Following Justin, we will have a session on campus security a subject that is at the forefront of every college administrators mind.

We look forward to seeing you and please visit our site often and look for updates!

Sincerely,
Your 2013 Conference Committee
